title: lantana urticifolia subsp. portoricensis
intro: Lantana urticifolia subsp. portoricensis, commonly known as the Puerto Rican lantana, is a subspecies of flowering shrub in the verbena family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lantana urticifolia subsp. portoricensis are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
